Beige vs White early adipogenesis analyed at the gene level

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r params}
module = "beige_vs_white"
dataname = "downsample"
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "supp_figS7_beige_vs_white-gene_level"
i_am(file.path("figures", paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
```


```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))

if (!dir.exists(odir)) dir.create(odir, recursive = TRUE)
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486", "#E31A1C")
clusters = MetBrewer::met.brewer("Redon", 12)
paired_clusters = c(rbind(colorspace::darken(clusters, amount=0.3),
                    colorspace::lighten(clusters, amount=0.3)))
cluster_levels = c("b3","b11","b8","b9","b6","b0","b7","b10","b5","b1","b2","b4")
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = 'Spectral'))
```

## C: Marker Gene plot

```{r}
norm.markers = read.delim(here(odir, "marker_genes.txt"))
norm.markers$cluster = factor(norm.markers$cluster, levels=0:max(as.integer(norm.markers$cluster)))
head(norm.markers)

filt.markers = as.data.frame(norm.markers %>% filter( pct.1 > 0.5) %>%
    arrange(avg_log2FC))
```

Add major time per cluster
```{r}
tcomp = read.delim(here(odir, "cluster_composition.txt"))
time_per_cluster = group_by(tcomp, seurat_clusters, time) %>% summarise(n_cells = sum(n_cells)) %>% 
  slice_max(n=1, order_by = n_cells) %>% select(seurat_clusters, time)
time_per_cluster
filt.markers = merge(filt.markers, time_per_cluster, by.x="cluster", by.y="seurat_clusters")
head(filt.markers)
```

```{r}
top.markers = as.data.frame(filt.markers %>% group_by(time,cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC))
top.markers
```


### plot
```{r marker_gene_by_time}
top.markers$gene = factor(top.markers$gene, levels=rev(unique(top.markers$gene)))
overlap.to.plot = filter(top.markers, gene %in% top.markers$gene)
overlap.to.plot$gene = factor(overlap.to.plot$gene, levels=levels(top.markers$gene))

ggplot(overlap.to.plot, aes(y=gene, size=abs(avg_log2FC), color=cluster,
                    x=cluster)) + 
    geom_point(colour="black",aes(size = avg_log2FC*1.5)) + geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values=clusters, guide="none") + 
    facet_grid(~time, scales="free_x", space="free_x") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x){paste0("b",x)}) +
    labs(size="Mean\nlog_2FC", x= "Beige & white clusters", y="Marker genes")
    
```


## D GO plot

```{r}
marker_go = read.delim(here(odir, "ORA_marker_genes.txt"))
marker_go$cluster = factor(paste0("b",marker_go$cluster), levels=cluster_levels)
head(marker_go)
```



```{r go_replace}
phrases= read.delim(here("data/gene_sets/abbreviations.txt"))
recap= read.delim(here("data/gene_sets/capitalisations.txt"))
```


```{r abrev_go}
drama_shorten = function(ont) {
  for (x in 1:nrow(phrases)){
    ont = gsub( phrases$phrase[x],phrases$abbreviation[x], ont, ignore.case = T)
  }
  a = abbreviate(gsub("_"," ", gsub("^[[:alpha:]]*_","",tolower(ont))),minlength=41, dot=T, named = F)
  a = stringr::str_to_sentence(a)
  for (i in 1:nrow(recap))
    a = gsub(sprintf("\\b%s\\b", recap$lowercase[i]),recap$capital[i],a, ignore.case = T)
  return(a)
}
```

```{r}
marker_go = mutate(marker_go, short_desc = drama_shorten(Description))
go_to_plot = filter(marker_go, p.adjust < 0.01 & time != "day0" & 
                        !grepl("EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL", ID )) %>% group_by(time, cluster) %>%
              slice_min(n = 2, order_by = data.frame(p.adjust, pvalue)) 
go_to_plot$short_desc = factor(go_to_plot$short_desc, levels=rev(unique(go_to_plot$short_desc)))
go_to_plot$ID
```
### plot

```{r E:cluster_go}
ggplot(go_to_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count)) + 
   geom_point(colour="black",aes(size = Count*1.5)) + geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values=clusters, guide="none")+ 
  labs(y=NULL, x="beige vs white cluster") + 
    facet_grid(~time, scales="free_x", space = "free_x")
```

```{r cluster_go_overlapping}
include_all_plot = filter(marker_go, Description %in% go_to_plot$Description & p.adjust < 0.01 &
                              time != "day0")
include_all_plot$short_desc = factor(include_all_plot$short_desc,
                                     levels=levels(go_to_plot$short_desc))
ggplot(include_all_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count)) + 
  geom_point(colour="black",aes(size = Count*1.5)) + geom_point()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) +scale_color_manual(values=clusters) +
    facet_grid(~time, scales="free_x", space = "free_x")
```
## E: Full Cluster composition test  **new**

```{r}
cluster_test_gene = read.delim(here(odir,"cluster_composition_test.tsv"))
cluster_test_gene$cluster = factor(cluster_test_gene$cluster, levels=cluster_levels)
head(cluster_test_gene)
```

```{r}
to_plot = dplyr::rename(cluster_test_gene, prop_beige=prop, conf.int.1_beige=conf.int.1, conf.int.2_beige=conf.int.2)
to_plot$prop_white = 1-to_plot$prop_beige
to_plot$conf.int.1_white = to_plot$conf.int.1_beige + (to_plot$prop_white - to_plot$prop_beige)
to_plot$conf.int.2_white = to_plot$conf.int.2_beige + (to_plot$prop_white - to_plot$prop_beige)
to_plot = pivot_longer(to_plot, matches("white|beige"), 
                       names_to = c(".value","condition"),
                       names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)",
                     )
to_plot = mutate(to_plot, 
                 condition = factor(condition, levels=c("white","beige")),
                 clu_pval_star = if_else(p.adjust < 0.01, paste(cluster, "**"),
                                 if_else(p.adjust < 0.05, paste(cluster, "*"),
                                         cluster)))
to_plot$cond.time = paste(to_plot$condition, sep=".", to_plot$time)
to_plot$cond.time = factor(to_plot$cond.time, levels=c("white.day1","white.day3","beige.day1","beige.day3"))
to_plot$clu.cond.time = paste(to_plot$cluster, sep=".", to_plot$cond.time)
to_plot 
```

```{r E_wvb_proportion_test}
ggplot(to_plot, aes(x=condition, fill=clu.cond.time, y=prop))  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linewidth=0.4, colour="grey55") + 
  geom_bar(position="dodge", stat='identity', show.legend = F) + 
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin=conf.int.1, ymax=conf.int.2), 
                 position=position_dodge(0.9), 
                 width=0.4, linewidth=0.3, colour="black") +
  facet_wrap(time~clu_pval_star,nrow=2, scales = "free_x")  +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0)) + scale_fill_manual(values=paired_clusters) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="Proportion of cells") 
```

## F: Beige vs white Volcano plots

### scRNAseq

```{r}
day1_test = read.delim(here(odir, "DE_day1_wvb.tsv"))
day3_test = read.delim(here(odir, "DE_day3_wvb.tsv"))
```

```{r F_upper_day1_volcano}
ggplot(day1_test, aes(x=avg_log2FC, y=-log10(p_val), colour=sig_cond)) + geom_point(size=0.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(data = slice_min(day1_test, n=20, order_by = p_val), aes(label=gene_name)) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(pal[4],"black",pal[2]))+ guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) +
  ggtitle("day1")+ coord_cartesian(x=c(-1,1))

ggplot(day1_test, aes(x=avg_log2FC, y=-log10(p_val), colour=sig_cond)) + geom_point(size=0.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(data = slice_min(day1_test, n=70, order_by = p_val), aes(label=gene_name)) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(pal[4],"black",pal[2])) + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) +
  ggtitle("day1 zoom") + coord_cartesian(x=c(-1,1), y=c(0, 100))
```


```{r F_lower_day3_volcano}

ggplot(day3_test, aes(x=avg_log2FC, y=-log10(p_val), colour=sig_cond)) + geom_point(size=0.5) + 
  geom_text_repel(data = slice_min(day3_test, n=70, order_by = p_val), aes(label=gene_name)) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(pal[5],"black",pal[1])) + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) +
  ggtitle("day3 zoom") + coord_cartesian(x=c(-1,1), y=c(0, 100)) 
```
